title: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 世界模型：加入实时音频、可中途改指令的场景与人物一致性翻倍
summary: Google DeepMind 于 10月28日 00:01（北京时间）以研究预览形式发布 Genie 4 世界模型，首次加入实时生成音频并支持中途改写场景，是本轮实验室消息中最热的一条。
summary_en: Google DeepMind released the Genie 4 world model as a research preview on October 28 at 00:01 Beijing time. The announcement says the model adds real-time generated audio and supports rewriting scenes midway. The title also claims that character and scene consistency have doubled, and describes the release as the hottest item among this round of laboratory news.
body:
Google DeepMind 于 10月28日 00:01（北京时间）以研究预览形式发布 Genie 4 世界模型，首次加入实时生成音频并支持中途改写场景，是本轮实验室消息中最热的一条。

Google DeepMind
